info.name: Foundation — API smoke tests
info.description: Canonical importable Collection v2.1. Requests 01-08 are the basic flow. Then run Administrator and standard scenarios on an isolated database: they persist users and role changes. Set all credentials only in a private local environment; never export captured tokens. Local YAML copies are historical and not the import source.

request.description: QA scenario: 3.1 - Public health and database outage. See docs/QA_TEST_PLAN.md. Use private local credentials only.

exec: pm.test("3.1 - Public health and database outage | HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("3.1 - Public health and database outage | Request interaction ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Interaction-ID")).to.match(/^[0-9]{24}$/));

request.description: QA scenario: 3.2 - Invalid credentials and bearer tokens. See docs/QA_TEST_PLAN.md. Use private local credentials only.

exec: pm.test("3.2 - Invalid credentials and bearer tokens | HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("3.2 - Invalid credentials and bearer tokens | Request interaction ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Interaction-ID")).to.match(/^[0-9]{24}$/));
if (pm.response.code === 200) {
const data = pm.response.json();
pm.test("3.2 - Invalid credentials and bearer tokens | Access token returned", () => pm.expect(data.access_token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty);
pm.collectionVariables.set("access_token", data.access_token);
} else { pm.collectionVariables.set("access_token", ""); }

query.description: Enable to filter by the ID captured after insertion.
Enable for a case-insensitive contains pattern. Keep percent signs raw here; Postman encodes them once.

request.description:
Use Params checkboxes: neither returns the first unfiltered page; id filters by inserted ID; value applies ILIKE; both combine with AND. Response is count/page/page_size/items. Optional page and page_size may be added in Params. Percent signs are encoded once.

QA scenario: 4.4 - Pagination counts limits and empty pages. See docs/QA_TEST_PLAN.md. Use private local credentials only.

exec: pm.test("4.4 - Pagination counts limits and empty pages | HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("4.4 - Pagination counts limits and empty pages | Request interaction ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Interaction-ID")).to.match(/^[0-9]{24}$/));
pm.test("4.4 - Pagination counts limits and empty pages | Pagination envelope", () => {
const data = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(data.items).to.be.an("array");
pm.expect(data.count).to.be.a("number").and.at.least(data.items.length);
pm.expect(data.page).to.be.at.least(1);
pm.expect(data.page_size).to.be.within(10, 50);
pm.expect(data.items.length).to.be.at.most(data.page_size);
